title: A Beginner-Auditable Replication of the FLI Index on a Newly Added Lab

original_idea.body: A Beginner-Auditable Replication of the FLI Index on a Newly Added Lab

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Extending standardized scoring broadens coverage but the chain to catastrophic-risk reduction has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Apply a faithful subset of public-evidence indicators to one lab; highly beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single mini-index card with documented coding.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public-evidence scoring of under-covered labs; no lab cooperation.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of an existing index on one more lab; largely addressed methodology.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Index methodology established; applying to one more lab is replication.
